comparison.objective: Thread and tighten a spin-on oil filter to a bounded post-contact rotation; candidate locks a lifting pin, transfers a workpiece, and recovers the pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled threaded rotation and torque/angle stopping versus axial pin alignment, button and ball-lock actuation, suspended-load control, seating, and extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Filter remains threaded within the allowed tightening-angle band and is released without over-tightening versus staged retention, lift, fixture support, withdrawal, clearance, and dwell checks.
comparison.reason: Shared guarded force control is generic; threaded tightening and temporary lifting-pin load transfer test different abilities, and no missing numeric detail creates plausible duplication.
